messages:
Maria Gonzalez: Vendor wants three short retest windows (canary, staging, prod-sim). Need: RBAC flow, KMS audit sample, evidence deposit path, and per-service smoke checks. Can we firm up owners? :calendar:
Omar Rahman: I can own canary + staging for runtime services. Prefer Thu 10:00-11:30 PST slot.
Priya Nair: I	will own api-gateway + auth; Tue 14:00-15:00 PST works. Need clarity on ephemeral assessor role creation and STS TTL.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: noted retention policy check scheduled at 1766546800 for audit indices.
Maria Gonzalez: KMS-audit-bot: we need a 24h sample of KeyUsage events showing Decrypt/GetPublicKey for the test keys. Can you produce an export?
KMS-audit-bot: KMS-audit-bot: I can export CloudTrail events to the readroom bucket. ETA ~ 2h. Output path: s3://redwood-pt-readroom/engagement-2026-03/kms-audit-sample.json.gz
Lina Torres: For RBAC: plan is ephemeral role + token service that mints STS creds with 3h TTL. Steps: 1) create role with GetDecrypt & ListKeys restricted to test key id, 2) attach inline policy with conditions (aws:RequestTag=pt-engagement), 3) map role to assessor group. I'll post the role ARN.
Priya Nair: What about production-sim traffic impact? Ops: can we divert 5% to fallback model? We need smoke to finish within 10 mins per attempt.
Omar Rahman: We	will run fallback in dry-run first. Script to use:
```
./ops/divert.sh --service inference-runtime --pct 5 --dry-run --tag pt-sim
```
I	'll attach dry-run logs in the matrix.
Maria Gonzalez: Evidence deposit: presigned uploads to s3://redwood-pt-readroom/engagement-2026-03/ via expiring links. Manifest format (JSON lines) with fields: service, artifact, uploader, sha256, timestamp. Example manifest line: {"service":"api-gateway","artifact":"patch-1234.diff","uploader":"ryan","sha256":"...","ts":"1766543210"}
Priya Nair: Quick smoke checklist (api-gateway):
- token mint -> verify 200
- small POST to /predict (100 tokens) -> 200
- trace header present in response
- logs show auth check pass
curl example:
```
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer test' https://staging.api.redwood/api/v1/predict -d '{"input":"ping"}' -v
```
Lina Torres: On KMS key policy: I'll restrict key usage to role ARN and add a condition for request time window. Also enabling KMS data events in CloudTrail for that key. Will post the policy snippet.
Maria Gonzalez: Remediation tracker - please add PR/commit + evidence link. Minimal matrix sample: Service | Fix | Owner | Status | Evidence
api-gateway | auth header validation | Priya Nair | ready | /readroom/engagement-2026-03/apigw/patch.json
inference-runtime | kv cache leak fix | Omar Rahman | in-progress | /readroom/engagement-2026-03/runtime/kv-fix.log
Maria Gonzalez: Action items: Lina post role ARN + key id; KMS-audit-bot post export path; everyone add PR/sha to tracker before EOD. I	want to publish slots to vendor tomorrow morning.
Priya Nair: One more ask: vendor needs a short on-call contact and escalation matrix. I'll draft a one-pager and drop it in the readroom.
Omar Rahman: Dry-run results will be uploaded to /readroom/engagement-2026-03/dryrun-logs/ by EOD today.
Maria Gonzalez: Great. If nothing else flagged, I'll send the proposed slots and the evidence plan to vendor at 18:00 UTC. :white_check_mark:
